notablePrerequisites: Tolsimir Wolfblood does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Tolsimir Wolfblood by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Voja legendary creature token.
If you control two Voja tokens, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Tolsimir Wolfblood.
Repeat.
